title: Rest & Relax at Firefly Cottage
description:
Escape to the serene beauty of Franklin, TN, where our charming cottage on 5 acres awaits you. Nestled in the woods, this tranquil oasis offers you a perfect blend of nature’s embrace and modern comfort. The screened-in porch and lower deck will be your new favorite spots to relax and have fun. Whether you’re seeking a peaceful getaway or a base for exploring the historic town of Franklin, which is just 15 min away, our property promises a restful haven for your stay.

The space
The master bedroom with attached full bathroom are on the main floor. The other two bedrooms and full bath are upstairs.

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire house and property. This includes the screened in upper porch and the lower porch and surrounding woods.

Other things to note
This is a non-smoking property. There is no grilling allowed on the property.
